_description: This file controls compression parameters for various image formats.
Validation: uses JSON Schema ./config.schema.json
The 'default' section contains settings applied to all images:
- maxSize: maximum image dimensions (width/height: 1-16384 or null)
- quality.opaque: quality for opaque images (1-100)
- quality.transparent: quality for transparent images (1-100)
- outputFormat.opaque: format for opaque images (jpg, jpeg, webp, none)
- outputFormat.transparent: format for transparent images (png, webp, none)
- formatOptions: advanced per-format settings (webp, jpeg, png)
Format-specific options:
- webp: quality, lossless, nearLossless, smartSubsample, effort, alphaQuality, minSize, mixed
- jpeg: quality, mozjpeg, progressive, optimizeCoding, trellisQuantisation, overshootDeringing, chromaSubsampling
- png: compressionLevel, progressive, palette, quality, effort, colors, dither
The 'custom' section allows overriding settings for specific images:
- maxSize: individual dimensions (overrides default.maxSize)
- quality: unified quality for all types (overrides both settings)
- outputFormat: unified output format (overrides both formats)
- formatOptions: per-format advanced settings (overrides default formatOptions)
- 'none' means preserve original format
Image name in 'custom' section must match filename without extension.
Examples: 'hero-banner', 'icon', 'T_Background' (without .png/.jpg/.webp etc.)
